system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: You are a senior software developer maintaining a large project.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only; prompt templates with {issue_content}/{collected_content} variables. Repository evidence is Jedi (a dependency), not the harness.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: we only use the location description of the relevant code fragments (i.e., structural dependencies in the repository) and the output of the Summary Agent (i.e., summary and planning) as Ling- maAgent's experience to guide subsequent actions.
env_context_strategy.note: MCTS with BM25 correlation expansion over a knowledge graph injects context; agent then navigates with search_class/search_method/search_code.

context_compaction.note: Summary agent condenses collected snippets, but history compaction is not described.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the retrieval API will search for classes, methods and code snippets in the repository knowledge graph, and finally return the results to the agent.

tool_count.evidence_quote: using the three-layer search method of search_class, search_method,
tool_count.note: search_class, search_method, search_code; patch generation not a tool per paper.

edit_primitive.note: Paper: generates modified snippets then a diff is computed; no explicit edit primitive named.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: LingmaAgent involves three key steps, repository knowledge graph construction stage, MCTS-enhanced repository understanding stage, information utilization & patch generation stage.
loop_primitives.note: MCTS for exploration; ReAct for dynamic info acquisition (Sec. 3.4).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: outputs a summary of the relevant fragments in sequence and plans a solution.
planning_granularity.note: Plan is free text from summary agent.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: To more effectively utilize the global repository information collected during the repository understand- ing phase, we introduce a summary agent.
multi_agent_topology.note: Reward agent, summary agent, main agent in fixed sequence.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: LingmaAgent attempted to re- solve issues without any human intervention.
human_in_loop.note: Human-in-the-loop only as an evaluation setting in product pipeline.

self_verification.evidence_quote: a static review of the patch by the review agent is added to discover possible defects in the newly generated code.
self_verification.note: Review agent is an ablation variant, not default; execution feedback variant also reported.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: set the maximum number of retries to 3 to ensure that the generated patch can be applied as much as possible.

termination_condition.note: MCTS capped at 600 iterations / 300 s; overall run termination not described.

timeouts.note: Only MCTS stage search time limit of 300 seconds.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: we use the well-build open source docker of the AutoCodeRover [53] team for experiments.

target_domain.evidence_quote: designed to comprehensively understand and utilize whole software repositories for issue resolution.

open_source.evidence_quote: we have open-sourced a Python prototype of LingmaAgent for reference by other industrial developers
open_source.note: Prototype only; production deployment closed. Licence not in evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: we experimented with different models and found that performance improved significantly with more advanced mod- els.
model_agnostic.note: GPT-4, GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet used; abstraction not shown.

primary_artifact.note: Supplied repository evidence is Jedi (dependency), not the LingmaAgent repo.

first_release_date.note: Paper v1 date not in evidence.

pinned_version.note: Evidence pinned Jedi v0.20.0, a mismatched repo.

stars.note: 6178 stars reported are for davidhalter/jedi, not the harness repo.
